key_findings: Biggest gap between views (proxy): Direct has 21% of first-touch credit against 17% of last-non-direct credit; every other channel moves by 2 points or less.

Most undervalued by last click: none. Every channel with enough volume is balanced (index 0.8 to 1.25), because 78% of engaged sessions happen on the day of the first visit and only 27% come from returning visitors, so channels mostly find and keep their own visitors.

Main risk: there is no outcome to attribute (no key event fired in the window, and no sign-up event was sent to this property), and paid traffic doesn't line up with paid spend. Channel credit and CPA can't be trusted until both are fixed.

tests_to_run.how: Find where sign-ups happen and make sure that page sends the sign-up event to this GA4 property, then rerun after 30 days with 30 or more sign-ups.

tests_to_run.test: Find the unexplained google / cpc traffic
tests_to_run.how: GA4 logged 14 google / cpc sessions with no spending Google Ads account behind them. Look for another Google Ads account that isn't connected, or links hand-tagged with utm_source=google and utm_medium=cpc; connect the account or retag the links. Confirmed when every google / cpc session in a new window matches a connected account's clicks.
Add the tags GA4 expects to the ads' final URLs (or turn on auto-tagging) and confirm bing / cpc sessions appear for the clicks.

tests_to_run.test: Ask new sign-ups how they heard about you
tests_to_run.how: One optional question at sign-up, compared with GA4's first-touch channel for the same people; it is the only check on organic channels that can't be paused.
